description: Mark a refresh task as applied (you successfully updated the memory/rule) or rejected (the suggestion was wrong or no longer relevant). If you already passed `refresh_id` to `pathrule_update_memory`/`_update_rule`, the task is auto-resolved and you can skip this call.

note.description: Optional — short note to the user about what you changed or why you rejected.

status.description: 'applied' when you updated the memory/rule; 'rejected' when you decided the suggestion is wrong or obsolete.

name: pathrule_resolve_refresh
title: Close a memory/rule refresh task
